decision.follow_on_rule: Use the triage output to select the smallest prospective, broker-native, read-only data extension only if its expected information gain exceeds acquisition cost; do not reopen either completed SESSION_GAP outer or rerun C031 Stage-B.

no returns, PnL, promotion statistics, or economic ranking
next_research_state.universe_scope: 1578 eligible post-exclusion broker-native frontier candidates remain open

objective.goal: Run the newly validated adaptive breadth triage over the accepted 40-symbol broker-native M5 development capture before selecting any mechanism-specific outer.
objective.information_gain_rationale: The accepted 40 representatives are sufficient for the next non-economic structural decision: they cover the frozen frontier's observed structural signatures with complete hash-bound M5 data and support chronology, cadence, alignment, and declared prerequisite checks. They are not sufficient to claim economic equivalence across the 1578 eligible frontier candidates or to close any mechanism family. Executing the zero-acquisition triage is higher expected information gain than immediately requesting another outer capture because it can rank viable cross-family data surfaces and identify the smallest justified prospective extension.
